relevant_chat.message: Much better. That field was getting a bit crowded anyway.
Alice, I'm looking for a bit of brick to finish my path. Would you be interested in some wood in exchange?
I'd love to help out, Charlie, but I don't have any brick either. Bob seems to be the only one sitting on the clay lately.
Well, at least the woods are providing. Since nobody has any clay to spare, I'll just hold onto these logs for now. Your turn, Alice.
Let's see if we can get something moving. These bricks are definitely playing hard to get.
Well, since the dice aren't giving us much to work with, I think I'll take matters into my own hands. Bob, you've been talking about keeping the wheat flowing... I'll take that quite literally.
Ouch, Alice. I guess 'literally' is one way to put it. I suppose I should be flattered you think I'm that good of a provider.
That's a lot of wheat, but I think I can find a better use for it than just making bread. Let's see if the bank is interested in a bulk deal.
Charlie, you've been a good ally. I'm just one bit of wheat short of getting this port running. Would you take a sheep for some wheat?
I'd love to help you out, Alice, but I'm completely dry on wheat over here. I haven't seen a single stalk of it since you cleared the table!
Ah, no wheat in the cards then? No worries, Charlie. It's a tough market out here today. I'll just hold steady for now. Over to you, Bob.
Alright, Alice, that monopoly was a clean sweep. Let's see if the dice are feeling any more generous than you are.
Alice, you've got those fresh bricks from the bank. How about swapping one for some wood? It's better than letting it sit while the robber stalks the board.
Nice try, Bob, but I'm not letting go of my only brick for wood I already have. You'll have to find someone else to bail you out.

You know, Bob, you talk a lot about 'balancing scales,' but I think it's time we actually leveled the field. That Wheat 8 was doing just fine without your 'guest.' Let's see how you like it when your bricks go missing for a change.
A bit dramatic for a simple knight, don't you think, Charlie? I'm just a humble merchant trying to keep the wheat flowing.
Alright, let's see what the dice have to say about this 'balance' you keep talking about, Bob.
Well, looks like the bricks are as dry as the desert right now. I'll just have to see what else I can find in the deck.
Tough market indeed, especially when someone corners the wheat supply! Let's see if the dice have a better sense of humor than the players.
Tough crowd today. I'll just hold onto these logs and hope the wind changes. Good luck, Charlie.
